expectations.text: File has YAML frontmatter with title, adr, status, date, authors, and changelog fields
expectations.evidence: YAML frontmatter present with all required fields

expectations.text: Document contains Motivation, Decision Drivers, Options, and Decision sections
expectations.evidence: All four sections present: Motivation, Decision Drivers, Options (A/B), Decision

expectations.text: Each option lists pros and cons referencing the same named decision drivers
expectations.evidence: Both options annotate all 3 named drivers (Developer experience, CI speed, Onboarding) with explicit +/- markers

expectations.text: Document includes a Consequences section with at least one good and one bad consequence
expectations.evidence: 4 Good and 3 Bad consequences explicitly labelled

expectations.text: ADR file is at docs/adrs/NNNN-*.md with zero-padded number and kebab-case name
docs/adrs/README.md exists and contains a table entry linking to the new ADR
expectations.evidence: README.md created with table entry confirmed by agent

expectations.text: Options section contains at least one specific current fact that goes beyond the user's original description
expectations.evidence: Turborepo actively maintained in its 2.x series as of early 2026; remote caching limitation on ephemeral CI runners documented; Turborepo JS/TS-only limitation flagged; Turborepo marginally slower than Nx on large task graphs per benchmarks — all specific researched facts
